comments.text: TPS stands for "Temporary Protected Status".  It is a humanitarian immigration designation granted by (DHS) to eligible foreign nationals of specific designated countries.  Temporary protection from deportation, allows work authorization, & grants travel authorization. Conditions & rules are the country's condition & current presents in the U.S.  This TPS offers "no direct" green card route & must be reviewed & approved by DHS every 18 months. As the TPS holder's country improves & safe to return, the TPS granted maybe revoked by DHS as deemed necessary & the migrant must return home.
